queries.intent: Reuse shared query stages for entity-events, event-runs
queries.objective: Establish the retained run-owned event evidence available for downstream import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: The result unions retained audit, domain, tool, and issue records with their available run identity; an empty or unavailable preview cannot establish zero source activity or complete import coverage.

queries.intent: Identify each workflow run that has one or more imported run-owned records.
queries.objective: Identify run attempts with retained imported records so their presence can be compared with observed runs.
queries.acceptance: One row per organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt contains events, the count of matching retained records; no row in an available result does not prove that no event was produced.
queries.description: Distinct workflow runs represented by imported domain, tool, audit, or issue records.

queries.intent: Identify observed runs that have one or more imported run-owned records.
queries.objective: Compare observed run attempts with retained run-owned event evidence to locate import-coverage gaps for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Keep each observed run and its run-attempt identity; imported-event-count is zero and imported is false without a matching retained event, but missing events alone do not establish an ingestion failure.
queries.description: Observed runs enriched with imported-record status.

queries.intent: Summarize observed run counts and imported runs by declared workflow.
queries.objective: Compare observed run attempts, conclusions, and imported-record coverage for each workflow.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; report distinct run-attempt totals, successful and failed conclusion counts, and imported-run totals only from retained evidence. Missing run records cannot establish zero execution.
queries.description: Observed run and imported-run totals for each declared workflow.

queries.intent: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by declared workflow.
queries.objective: Expose retained AI Credit consumption per workflow for bounded cost review alongside observed execution.
queries.acceptance: Return the sum of recorded aic-total by organization, repository, and workflow; missing usage or runs is not evidence of zero actual cost.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals for each declared workflow.

queries.intent: Prepare MCP tool calls for aggregation with safe-output-server calls identified for downstream exclusion.
queries.objective: Identify retained MCP call labels and safe-output-server classification for downstream tool-use investigation.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each retained call with its workflow key and tool label and mark safe-output-server calls explicitly; downstream exclusion must not be mistaken for absence of those calls or complete tool telemetry.
queries.description: Observed MCP tool calls labeled with whether they belong to the internal safe outputs server.

queries.intent: List retained GitHub issue safe outputs.
queries.objective: Inspect retained issue safe outputs and their observed closure state before deciding which items need follow-up.
queries.acceptance: Include only safe_output.created issue records, not pull requests; preserve issue and run links, timestamps, state, and status detail. Unknown or unobserved closure state must not be presented as closed.
queries.description: Issue-only projection of retained safe-output items.

queries.intent: Rank the ten repositories with the most retained GitHub issue safe outputs.
queries.objective: Locate repositories with the largest observed issue-safe-output volume for a bounded review of linked records.
queries.acceptance: Return at most ten repository coordinates ordered by retained issue-record count; ties or missing issue evidence must not imply a complete fleet ranking or unique issue count.
queries.description: Top repositories by retained issue safe-output count.

queries.intent: List declared workflows with their campaign, repository, configuration, and observed execution totals.
queries.objective: Compare declared workflow configuration with retained run, import-coverage, and AI Credit evidence to select a workflow for closer inspection.
queries.acceptance: Keep one row per declared workflow with identity, role, mode, registration, links, observed totals, and ingestion indicator; zero joined totals and missing evidence must not be treated as proof of no execution or complete ingestion.
queries.description: Central campaign and repository-owned workflow inventory with observed execution totals.

queries.intent: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by repository.
queries.objective: Provide repository-level retained AI Credit totals for comparing observed usage with run activity.
queries.acceptance: Sum recorded aic-total by organization and repository; an absent or partial run history does not support a claim of zero actual consumption.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals for each repository.

queries.intent: Group installed and current gh-aw compiler versions and upgrade evidence by repository.
queries.objective: Identify repositories with declared Markdown workflows whose retained compiler-version evidence warrants upgrade review.
queries.acceptance: Group Markdown workflow declarations by repository coordinate and return distinct recorded installed/current version lists plus upgrade-required and unknown flags; inspect absent or mixed version evidence rather than inferring a repository-wide installed version.

queries.intent: List each repository with recorded compiler versions and computed upgrade state.
queries.objective: Expose recorded compiler versions and computed upgrade state per repository so an operator can inspect update signals and gaps.
queries.acceptance: Return repository, recorded version lists, upgrade-required flag, and computed upgrade-state; mixed or absent version evidence requires inspection before any decision, and an upgrade label does not authorize a rollout or policy change.

queries.intent: Expose at most one CAO package update row for the Updates navigation indicator.
queries.objective: Determine whether retained campaign metadata contains an update-available signal for the Updates indicator.
queries.acceptance: Return zero or one campaign-update-state row only when it equals update-available; an empty result means no matching retained signal, not that every campaign is current.

queries.intent: Expose at most one gh-aw compiler upgrade row for the Updates navigation indicator.
queries.objective: Determine whether repository compiler metadata contains an upgrade-required signal for the Updates indicator.
queries.acceptance: Return zero or one upgrade-required row only when the retained value is 1; no row does not establish that all repositories are current when version data is missing.

queries.intent: Project retained report-incomplete terminal outcomes as concise run diagnoses.
queries.objective: Find retained report_incomplete safe outputs that can explain a specific run's incomplete reporting.
queries.acceptance: Include only matching audit safe_output.created records with run-attempt identity, outcome kind, and recorded diagnosis; absence is not proof that reporting completed.
queries.description: One retained incomplete-evidence diagnosis per workflow Run when the agent explicitly reported that required evidence or access was unavailable.

queries.intent: Project workflow runs with campaign attribution and retained failure evidence.
queries.objective: Connect retained run status and failure details to declared campaign/workflow identity for run-level diagnosis.
queries.acceptance: Expose run and attempt identity, declared attribution, runtime and target repositories, status, failure and incomplete-outcome evidence, timestamps, and drill-down links; do not infer an outcome from runtime success or missing details.
queries.description: Canonical workflow runs joined to their declared campaign and workflow identity.

queries.intent: Project only the run and workflow fields required to classify current campaign runtime health.
queries.objective: Provide the retained run identity, timing, role, dispatch type, repository, and status needed to assess campaign runtime-health groups.
queries.acceptance: Project the selected fields from overview-runs without converting missing statuses or unattributed workflows into failures; unavailable run history leaves health assessment incomplete.
queries.description: A bounded runtime-health input that excludes audit outcomes and presentation-only campaign run fields.

queries.intent: Compute each campaign workflow and runtime repository's latest consecutive failure streak in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Locate campaign workflow/runtime-repository groups whose most recent retained completed runs have consecutive runtime failures.
queries.acceptance: Group completed runs by campaign, workflow, role, dispatch type, and runtime repository; failure-count is the latest retained failure streak, not a rate or a claim about runs outside the available horizon.
queries.description: Current retained failure streaks grouped by campaign workflow and runtime repository, considering only concluded Runs so an in-flight retry cannot mask an active failure streak.

queries.intent: Mark campaign workflow and runtime repository partitions whose latest retained run streak is failing.
queries.objective: Flag runtime-health groups with a nonzero latest retained failure streak for focused investigation.
queries.acceptance: Preserve the group identity and failure-count; has-current-failure reflects only failure-count greater than zero, while absent or incomplete run evidence cannot establish health.
queries.description: Campaign runtime partitions annotated with whether their current retained streak contains failures.

queries.intent: Show only campaign workflow and runtime repository partitions whose latest retained run streak is failing.
queries.objective: Select failing retained runtime-health partitions for review of their underlying runs.
queries.acceptance: Return only groups flagged has-current-failure with their identity and streak count in declared order; no rows mean no matching observed streak, not verified healthy operation.
queries.description: Campaign runtime partitions with one or more consecutive failures after their latest retained success.

queries.intent: Count retained Runs for each workflow identity in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Measure retained run presence by workflow identity to compare with active orchestrator declarations.
queries.acceptance: Count overview-runs by organization, repository, and workflow; a missing group indicates no retained matching run in the available horizon, not proof of no executions.
queries.description: One row per organization, repository, and workflow with retained Run counts, safe to join without row multiplication.

queries.intent: Count retained Runs for each active campaign orchestrator in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Compare active orchestrator declarations with retained run observations to identify missing visibility.
queries.acceptance: Keep only workflows declared active with orchestrator role and expose their identity, runtime repository, and observed-run-count; a zero joined count means no retained match, not necessarily a stopped schedule.
queries.description: Active campaign orchestrators annotated with retained Run presence.

queries.intent: Mark active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Mark active orchestrators lacking retained run evidence for bounded telemetry or schedule review.
queries.acceptance: Preserve active orchestrator identity and observed-run-count; is-unobserved marks zero retained matches and must not be interpreted as a runtime failure or evidence that dispatch was expected.
queries.description: Active orchestrators annotated with whether runtime evidence is absent.

queries.intent: Show active campaign orchestrators with no retained Runs in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: List active orchestrator declarations with no retained run observations for follow-up on evidence availability.
queries.acceptance: Return only is-unobserved candidates with their workflow and repository identity; an empty result does not certify run completeness or scheduler health.
queries.description: Active campaign orchestrators whose runtime state cannot be established from retained evidence.

queries.intent: Combine current runtime failures with active orchestrators that have no retained Run evidence.
queries.objective: Present observed failing streaks and unobserved active orchestrators together, without conflating the two conditions.
queries.acceptance: Union the two candidate sets with their problem kind and identifying context; missing run evidence remains an observation gap rather than a confirmed runtime failure.
queries.description: Current campaign runtime problems requiring investigation.

queries.intent: Select workflow-dispatch runs from campaign-attributed workflow run evidence.
queries.objective: Inspect retained workflow_dispatch runs attributed to campaigns before comparing campaign dispatch activity.
queries.acceptance: Include only campaign-runs with event workflow_dispatch and preserve run, attempt, attribution, status, and time; absence does not establish that no dispatch occurred beyond retained evidence.
queries.description: Canonical workflow runs whose authoritative trigger is workflow_dispatch.

queries.intent: Summarize observed workflow dispatches for each centrally managed campaign.
queries.objective: Compare retained workflow_dispatch run counts across attributed campaigns.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct run identifiers per campaign from dispatches; do not treat missing campaign attribution or unretained dispatches as zero actual activity.
queries.description: Observed workflow-dispatch run totals grouped by campaign.

queries.intent: Summarize observed workflow and execution totals for each centrally managed campaign.
queries.objective: Compare declared orchestrator/worker composition, rollout registration, observed runs, and AI Credit usage by campaign.
queries.acceptance: Group only orchestrator and worker workflow-inventory rows by campaign; retain workflow count, distinct roles/modes/registration and summed observed runs and AIC, without inferring successful outcomes.
queries.description: Observed workflow, rollout, run, and AI Credit totals grouped by campaign.

queries.intent: Count distinct registered target repositories reached by successful worker dispatches for each campaign.
queries.objective: Estimate observed campaign target reach from successful worker workflow_dispatch runs joined to registered repositories.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct matched target-repository values per campaign only for successful worker dispatches; this is observed reach, not verified target outcomes or complete fleet coverage.
queries.description: Campaign repository coverage derived from successful worker dispatch runs in the selected horizon.

queries.intent: List centrally managed campaigns with their observed workflow and execution totals.
queries.objective: Compare declared campaigns with retained workflow composition, dispatches, target reach, runs, and AIC to choose an evidence-backed drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep declared campaigns with campaign identity and link plus joined totals; defaulted zero values mean no matching retained evidence and cannot certify no activity, complete coverage, or successful outcomes.
queries.description: Canonical campaign inventory enriched with observed workflow, rollout, run, repository coverage, and AI Credit totals.

queries.intent: Show each observed firewall domain with the number of runs and total accepted and blocked requests.
queries.objective: Identify domains with observed denied requests for a closer review of firewall evidence.
queries.acceptance: Report distinct observed runs and native accepted and blocked request totals by domain; a denied request alone does not justify allowing egress, and no row does not prove no requests occurred.
queries.description: Distinct runs and accepted and blocked request totals by firewall domain.

queries.intent: Highlight the domains with the most blocked firewall requests.
queries.objective: Prioritize up to ten observed domains by blocked request total for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rank by observed blocked totals and inspect underlying domain/workflow evidence before deciding whether a block needs attention; the ranking is not a policy authorization or an incidence rate.
queries.description: The ten domains with the highest observed blocked request totals.

queries.intent: Show workflows that allowed or blocked requests to each observed firewall domain.
queries.objective: Locate which observed workflows contributed accepted or denied requests for a domain.
queries.acceptance: Preserve workflow scope, source link, distinct runs, and native accepted and blocked totals; investigate the run and egress context rather than assuming a denied request is a failure or grounds for wider access.
queries.description: Workflow-level accepted and blocked request totals by firewall domain.

queries.intent: Group observed MCP activity by tool and count calls and calling workflows, excluding the internal safe outputs server.
queries.objective: Expose tool-level call, workflow, and byte totals to investigate observed MCP usage.
queries.acceptance: Group only observed non-safe-output-server calls by server and tool, preserving counts and byte totals; lack of calls does not establish no access, and call volume does not establish value or permission.
queries.description: Observed MCP tool-call totals grouped by MCP server and tool, with the number of distinct calling workflows.

queries.intent: Show the ten most frequently called MCP tools.
queries.objective: Identify up to ten tools with the highest observed non-safe-output-server call counts for inspection.
queries.acceptance: Rank observed calls by tool label and inspect grouped tool evidence before drawing conclusions; do not treat popularity as effectiveness or authority to add tools.
queries.description: The ten MCP tools with the most observed calls, excluding the internal safe outputs server.

queries.intent: Prepare observed gateway steering warnings for aggregation by steering type and workflow.
queries.objective: Expose warning identity, run context, type, and timestamp for downstream steering diagnostics.
queries.acceptance: Project recorded gateway steering events with workflow and run attribution where available; a warning is not a completed budget overrun, failure, or reason to increase limits.
queries.description: Gateway steering warnings emitted when a run approaches its AI Credit budget, time limit, or another declared limit, labelled with a readable steering type.

queries.intent: Show how often each kind of steering warning occurred.
queries.objective: Identify steering warning categories to inspect in their run context.
queries.acceptance: Report observed event totals and distinct runs and workflows by type; confirm underlying warnings before interpreting frequency, and do not infer actual limit breaches.
queries.description: Observed gateway steering warnings grouped by steering type with the number of affected runs and workflows.

queries.intent: Count steering warnings for each workflow.
queries.objective: Expose workflow-level warning totals and token/time warning breakdowns for downstream review.
queries.acceptance: Count recorded events and distinct runs by workflow, retaining the declared token/time categories; other types remain in total events and no warning alone establishes a failure.
queries.description: Gateway steering warnings grouped by workflow, split into token-budget and time-limit warnings.

queries.intent: Present workflow steering totals with a link to each workflow dashboard.
queries.objective: Show observed workflow steering totals with navigation to the affected run context.
queries.acceptance: Keep workflow identity, link, events, runs, and warning breakdowns tied to their grouped evidence; use drill-through before recommending changes, not warning counts as a basis to widen budgets.
queries.description: Workflow steering totals labelled with a link to the workflow runtime page.

queries.intent: Highlight the workflows with the most steering warnings.
queries.objective: Prioritize up to ten workflows by observed warning count for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rank recorded warning totals with workflow context, checking underlying events and telemetry coverage; a high rank neither proves overrun nor justifies a limit change.
queries.description: The ten workflows with the highest observed gateway steering warning totals.

queries.intent: Summarize run outcomes and AI Credit consumption for reusable workflow cards.
queries.objective: Compare retained run-attempt activity, recorded conclusions, and AI Credit usage per workflow card.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; expose distinct run-attempt count, success/failure conclusion counts, and sum of recorded AIC, without treating missing run history as zero actual activity.

queries.intent: Project workflow entities for reusable workflow cards and repository drill-down.
queries.objective: Relate declared workflows to observed run and AIC totals for workflow-level drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Keep declared workflow identity, role, registration, campaign, link, and joined totals; a missing run match defaults to displayed zeros but does not establish no executions or outcomes.

queries.intent: Project canonical runs into repository-addressable run evidence.
queries.objective: Expose retained run chronology and status for a selected repository's drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Retain repository coordinate, workflow, run identity, title, event, start time, conclusion, mode, AIC, and run link; absent details or runs do not establish a healthy or idle repository.
queries.description: Workflow runs with a stable repository route key.

queries.intent: Summarize declared and disabled workflow counts by repository.
queries.objective: Compare declared and disabled workflow counts for each repository in the retained workflow inventory.
queries.acceptance: Count declared workflows and workflow-active=false entries by organization and repository; missing declarations must not be interpreted as a complete zero-workflow inventory.
queries.description: Declared and disabled workflow totals for each repository.

queries.intent: Summarize published outcome report counts by repository.
queries.objective: Show retained outcome-report volume per repository for comparison with observed execution.
queries.acceptance: Count retained outcome rows by organization and repository; a missing aggregate does not prove no reports were published or that reported outcomes succeeded.
queries.description: Published report totals for each repository.

queries.intent: Summarize distinct runs, failures, and approval-required runs by repository.
queries.objective: Compare retained run volume, selected failure and action-required conclusions, and imported-record presence per repository.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization and repository; preserve distinct run IDs, configured failure/action-required conclusion counts, and imported-run sums. Missing enrichment or run history must not be treated as complete coverage.
queries.description: Distinct run and conclusion totals for each repository.

queries.intent: Join each repository with its workflow, report, and run totals.
queries.objective: Attach retained workflow, report, and run aggregates to each repository for bounded inventory review.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each repository and the available joined aggregates by organization and repository; unmatched metrics remain missing evidence, not confirmed zero activity or evaluated outcomes.
queries.description: Repository inventory joined with workflow, report, evaluation, and run totals.

queries.intent: Show repository-level execution health, outcome activity, and AI Credit usage in an actionable inventory.
queries.objective: Prioritize repository drill-down using declared workflows, observed runs, reports, failures, import coverage, and AIC.
queries.acceptance: Return repository identity and link with retained counts, ingestion indicator, failure summary, AIC, and computed status; statuses describe retained evidence only, and an empty or unavailable preview cannot verify health, outcomes, or zero activity.
queries.description: Repository-local execution health and attributed outcome totals.

queries.intent: Project run entities for reusable run cards and workflow drill-down.
queries.objective: Expose retained run-attempt identity, execution timing, conclusion, and link for a bounded workflow-run inspection.
queries.acceptance: Keep organization, repository, workflow, run and attempt with status, conclusion, event, branch, duration, timestamps, and run link; missing timing or conclusion remains unknown rather than inferred success.

queries.intent: Project canonical runs into route-addressable workflow run evidence.
queries.objective: Trace retained runs and recorded failure evidence for a selected workflow route.
queries.acceptance: Preserve workflow route, run identity, start/end, status, conclusion, failure fields, mode, engine/model metadata, and run link; missing failure details do not prove success or rule out incomplete import.
queries.description: Workflow runs with a stable repository and workflow route key.

queries.intent: Project retained outcomes into route-addressable workflow reports.
queries.objective: Review retained workflow outcome reports separately from execution status before interpreting operational results.
queries.acceptance: Keep route, safe output, report title and summary, recorded status, category, observation time, metadata, and external link; missing reports or status do not imply success or no work.
queries.description: Workflow outcome reports with stable route keys and disposition fields.

queries.intent: Aggregate high- and medium-severity audit events with the same severity and summary by workflow.
queries.objective: Select recurring high- or medium-severity audit summaries for run-level investigation.
queries.acceptance: Each bucket's event count is traceable to retained audit or tool observations with the same campaign, severity, workflow, and summary; missing workflow attribution stays unknown, and a count alone does not verify impact.
queries.description: High- and medium-severity audit event counts grouped by severity, workflow, and shared summary.

queries.intent: List campaign-owned orchestrator and worker workflows with database-backed execution totals.
queries.objective: Choose an active campaign workflow whose observed execution warrants inspection.
queries.acceptance: Listed workflows match active declared orchestrator or worker inventory entries; runs and AI Credits agree with the selected-horizon inventory, and absence is not evidence of disabled authority or no executions. Rollout mode is context, not permission to change policy.
queries.description: Campaign workflows projected from the canonical workflow inventory.

queries.intent: Project retained outcomes into campaign-addressable report evidence.
queries.objective: Identify a campaign report whose durable outcome record needs follow-up.
queries.acceptance: Each report's campaign, title, source link, observation time, and disposition match its retained outcome; missing status is labeled unknown rather than accepted or resolved, and report production is not verified impact.
queries.description: Campaign outcome reports with database-backed disposition fields.

queries.intent: Project issue outcomes created by campaign worker workflows.
queries.objective: Choose a campaign worker issue whose current recorded disposition needs review.
queries.acceptance: Every included issue outcome joins a declared worker on organization, repository, and workflow and retains its issue, run, and status evidence; missing closing details remain unknown and closure is not proof of resolution.
queries.description: Campaign-addressable issue outcomes restricted to declared worker workflows.

queries.intent: Count the retained worker issues available for each campaign Reports tab.
queries.objective: Decide whether a campaign has retained worker issue reports to inspect.
queries.acceptance: For each returned campaign, items equals the number of rows in campaign-worker-issues for that campaign in the same horizon; missing campaigns are not treated as zero issues or verified resolution.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of retained issue outcomes produced by campaign workers.

queries.intent: Resolve one repository link for each campaign README from its declared orchestrator workflow.
queries.objective: Locate the declared orchestrator repository to contextualize a campaign README.
queries.acceptance: Each returned campaign and repository link traces to a declared orchestrator workflow; missing or multiple declarations are reported as uncertain rather than inventing a canonical repository.

queries.intent: Present retained campaign README content with its repository-relative link context.
queries.objective: Open the campaign's retained README in its declared repository context before relying on its guidance.
queries.acceptance: The README text and path match the campaign record and any repository link resolves through a declared orchestrator; absent content or repository linkage remains unavailable, not inferred.

queries.intent: Provide the registered campaigns whose repository memory can be browsed together.
queries.objective: Choose a registered campaign for repository-memory inspection.
queries.acceptance: Each campaign identity and display name matches the retained campaign registry in the selected scope; listing a campaign does not establish that memory observations exist or are complete.
queries.description: Registered campaigns ordered for the all-campaign repository-memory browser.

queries.intent: Summarize concluded campaign run outcomes by repository and UTC day as aligned context for operational-value history.
queries.objective: Identify repository-days with failed or missing concluded run activity to inspect beside operational-value observations.
queries.acceptance: For each campaign, repository, and UTC started-at day, distinct concluded, successful, and failed attempt counts reconcile to retained completed campaign runs under their declared statuses; other conclusions remain separate, and temporal alignment is not causal evidence.
queries.description: Daily repository success, failure, and other concluded-run counts for visual association only; these observations do not establish causation.

queries.intent: Provide daily repository run outcomes as nearby context for operational-value observations.
queries.objective: Spot repository-day reliability changes worth checking against the underlying run attempts.
queries.acceptance: The percent equals 100 times successful-runs divided by concluded-runs for the same repository-day when the denominator exists; zero or missing denominators remain undefined, and the rate is not operational value.
queries.description: Repository success and failure counts for temporal proximity only, without converting run outcomes into operational value or implying causation.

queries.intent: Summarize concluded campaign run outcomes by UTC day as aligned context for weighted campaign operational-value history.
queries.objective: Identify campaign-days with changed run-outcome counts for follow-up at repository level.
queries.acceptance: Each campaign-day's concluded, successful, and failed counts equal sums of its retained repository-day counts; absent repository days are not assumed to be zero, and aggregate run success does not establish operational impact.
queries.description: Daily campaign-wide success context aggregated from repository run-day counts without implying a causal relationship.

queries.intent: Provide daily campaign-wide run outcomes as nearby context for weighted operational-value observations.
queries.objective: Compare campaign-day runtime reliability with nearby value observations before selecting days to investigate.
queries.acceptance: Success rate is successful-runs divided by concluded-runs, expressed as a percent only where the denominator exists; the numerator and denominator remain inspectable, and co-occurrence does not establish causality or operational value.
queries.description: Campaign success and failure counts for temporal proximity only, without implying a causal relationship.

queries.intent: Establish a selected-horizon campaign baseline from concluded run attempts while keeping reliability, unverified production, and efficiency as separate facts.
queries.objective: Select campaigns whose retained run reliability, output production, or AI Credit efficiency merits closer examination.
queries.acceptance: For each campaign, concluded and successful attempt counts, output counts, and mean AI Credits reconcile to the corresponding filtered retained run attempts; absent denominators or costs stay unknown, and produced outputs are unverified outcomes, not operational value.
queries.description: Canonical campaign run attempts aggregated into bounded selected-horizon baseline totals without treating runtime success or produced outputs as operational value.

queries.intent: Turn each campaign's selected-horizon baseline totals into deterministic reliability and production signals with an explicit successful-run efficiency fact.
queries.objective: Decide which campaign baseline signal needs run- or output-level verification next.
queries.acceptance: Success-rate and signal labels follow the retained totals and their explicit denominators; no concluded attempts or output evidence is distinguished from zero verified impact, and AI Credits per successful run remain a separate cost fact rather than a value score.
queries.description: A bounded, explainable baseline that distinguishes runtime reliability, unverified output production, and AI Credit efficiency.

queries.intent: List retained failed runs for campaign problem investigation.
queries.objective: Choose a recent failed campaign run to investigate with its diagnostic evidence.
queries.acceptance: Each row corresponds to a retained campaign run with a declared failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out status and is ordered newest first; absence is not proof of healthy execution or complete ingestion.
queries.description: Failed campaign runs ordered from newest to oldest with retained diagnostic metadata.

queries.intent: Attach the current campaign runtime problem summary to each retained failed Run for that partition.
queries.objective: Inspect the failure count and problem kind alongside a failed run without inferring its root cause.
queries.acceptance: Each returned row joins a retained failed run to a runtime problem on campaign, workflow, and runtime repository; the inner join drops unmatched runs, so compare with campaign-problem-runs before interpreting absence as no problem.
queries.description: Failed campaign runs annotated with the failure-count and problem-kind of their active runtime problem, one row per retained failed Run.

queries.intent: Identify the most recent retained failed Run for each campaign workflow target repository.
queries.objective: Select the latest retained failed run identity for each campaign workflow and target partition.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, workflow, runtime repository, and target repository, latest-target-run agrees with the maximum retained failed run identity in that partition; a missing partition is not a healthy target.
queries.description: One row per campaign workflow and target repository with its most recent retained failed Run identity.

queries.intent: Cluster retained failed Run evidence by workflow, runtime repository, target repository, and error signature so repeated identical failures for one target collapse into one diagnosable group.
queries.objective: Rank repeated target-specific error signatures for investigation without merging unrelated failures.
queries.acceptance: Each group's occurrence-count and latest-run match retained joined failed runs sharing all declared grouping fields, including campaign, workflow, repositories, problem kind, and signature; unknown signatures may group together and counts do not prove a root cause.
queries.description: One row per distinct target repository and error signature within a campaign runtime problem partition, with an occurrence count and the most recent matching Run identity for follow-up.

queries.intent: Keep only the newest error signature for each campaign workflow target repository.
queries.objective: Focus investigation on the signature associated with the latest retained failed run per target.
queries.acceptance: Each returned group joins campaign-problem-latest-target-runs on campaign, workflow, runtime repository, and latest run ID; target repository is not a join key, so verify target identity against underlying runs before claiming one current signature per target.
queries.description: Current target-specific error groups whose representative Run is the target repository's most recent retained failed Run.

queries.intent: Attach the most recent representative Run evidence to each distinct campaign runtime problem error signature.
queries.objective: Open the representative failed run and target for each current campaign problem group.
queries.acceptance: For joined failure items, inspect run-link and the matching run ID, campaign, workflow, and runtime repository; target repository is not a join key, so verify it against run evidence. Unioned unobserved orchestrators need separate inventory review and may have no run link. Missing links and diagnostics remain unknown; rollout mode does not authorize policy changes.
queries.description: Current campaign runtime problems represented by the newest error signature for each target repository, with its effective rollout mode, an occurrence count, the most recent matching failed Run, and a repair prompt.

queries.intent: Count the current runtime problem items available for each campaign Problems tab.
queries.objective: Determine whether the campaign has current retained failure groups requiring review.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals the number of campaign-problem-items rows in the same horizon; a missing count does not establish zero failures or healthy execution.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of current runtime problem groups.

queries.intent: Project numeric repository-level campaign operational-value observations into temporal series with native units and direction.
queries.objective: Choose a repository and native operational-value measure whose observed trend needs evidence review.
queries.acceptance: Each plotted point carries its observation time, repository, definition key, native unit and direction; the projection omits null or nonnumeric values rather than replacing them with zero. Point-level maturity is not projected: requery operational-values and campaign-operational-value-evidence-state before interpreting any trend as matured evidence, and do not infer causality.
queries.description: Repository operational-value numeric series; point-level maturity and missing values require source observation review.

queries.intent: Summarize whether selected-horizon repository operational-value observations include matured evidence or only interim evidence.
queries.objective: Determine whether the campaign has matured value observations available for inspection.
queries.acceptance: Observation-count matches retained timestamped observations and matured-observation-count counts only non-null native values with matured status for the same campaign and horizon; missing campaigns do not imply zero value or no evidence.
queries.description: Campaign-level maturity counts used to distinguish interim from matured operational-value evidence.

queries.intent: Classify selected-horizon repository operational-value evidence by maturity without changing native values.
queries.objective: Decide whether to inspect matured observations or label the campaign's value evidence interim.
queries.acceptance: Evidence-state is observed-value only when matured-observation-count is positive, otherwise interim-evidence for a returned campaign; this classification neither changes native measure values nor upgrades missing or interim evidence to a verified outcome.
queries.description: Campaign-level evidence state consumed by the repository operational-value history presenter.

queries.intent: Describe each repository operational-value plot rendered on campaign Insights.
queries.objective: Identify which repository operational-value plots are backed by available series evidence.
queries.acceptance: Every plot entry derives from a primary-series group with its repository, native measure definition, unit, and direction; neither null-only observations nor point-level maturity are represented, so requery operational-values before treating an empty inventory as zero value or a plot as matured evidence.
queries.description: Plot inventory derived from numeric repository operational-value series; maturity must be checked separately.

queries.intent: Describe the rendered audit-summary chart using the shared campaign Insights plot contract.
queries.objective: Find campaigns with retained high- or medium-severity audit summaries worth reviewing.
queries.acceptance: Each campaign's bucket count equals its retained audit-event-summary-buckets rows; the count describes displayed groups, not distinct incidents or confirmed harm, and missing buckets are not proof of safety.
queries.description: One plot-inventory row per campaign when its high- and medium-severity audit summary chart has data.

queries.intent: Inventory every plot rendered on each campaign Insights page through one reusable plot contract.
queries.objective: Choose an available campaign Insights plot to inspect its underlying evidence.
queries.acceptance: Each plot entry is supplied by the repository value or audit summary plot inventory for the same campaign; no plot count is treated as outcome quality, and unavailable evidence is not synthesized into a plot.
queries.description: One campaign row per rendered Insights plot, independent of the plot's data source or renderer.

queries.intent: Count the plots declared by the shared campaign Insights plot inventory.
queries.objective: Determine whether a campaign has evidence-backed Insights plots to inspect.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals its rows in campaign-insight-plot-inventory for the same horizon; absent rows do not establish absent value, and plot counts do not measure impact.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of rendered Insights plots, independent of plot type.

queries.intent: Prepare repository coverage for the presentation-ready Overview station.
queries.objective: Format repository reach with its reached and registered counts for the station.
queries.acceptance: The percentage and detail preserve overview-repository-coverage's numerator and denominator; unavailable coverage remains unavailable, not zero or complete reach.

queries.intent: Provide the presentation-ready repository coverage station for Overview.
queries.objective: Show observed registered-repository worker reach and run motion in one station.
queries.acceptance: Value and formatted evidence match the coverage presentation input, and active matches run motion; neither changes policy or establishes accepted outcomes.

queries.intent: Identify campaigns whose dispatcher is disabled in GitHub Actions.
queries.objective: Surface campaigns with observed inactive orchestrator workflows for operator verification.
queries.acceptance: disabled-dispatchers counts workflow-role orchestrator records with workflow-active false per campaign; verify current GitHub state before acting, and do not infer a policy change.

queries.intent: Provide one navigation row per registered campaign that opens its dedicated campaign view.
queries.objective: Let operators navigate to each campaign while showing observed dispatcher and runtime-problem indicators.
queries.acceptance: Each row retains its canonical campaign identity and link, with indicator counts derived only from the named inputs; missing status does not mean enabled or healthy.
queries.description: Registered campaigns with a resolved dashboard link to their dedicated campaign view.

queries.intent: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by centrally managed campaign.
queries.objective: Identify campaigns whose observed AI Credit use needs investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rows preserve native aic values and descending order; investigate fresh campaign runs and snapshot completeness before suggesting a cost intervention, without inferring savings or value.

queries.intent: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository.
queries.objective: Locate repositories with higher observed AI Credit totals for evidence-led investigation.
queries.acceptance: Each repository coordinate and native aic total agrees with repository-aic-totals; confirm the selected horizon and underlying runs before attributing cost or proposing a change.

queries.intent: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository-owned workflow.
queries.objective: Locate repository workflows with higher observed AI Credit totals and open their workflow evidence.
queries.acceptance: Workflow identity, link, and native aic total match workflow-aic-totals in descending order; cost alone does not establish waste, quality, or value.

queries.intent: Present the average observed AI Credit cost of a single run for each repository-owned workflow.
queries.objective: Compare observed AI Credit per run across repository workflows with each observed-runs denominator.
queries.acceptance: aic-per-run is derived from native aic and observed-runs for matching workflows only; missing or zero denominators remain unavailable, and differences are not claimed as efficiency gains.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals divided by observed run attempts for each declared workflow.

queries.intent: Select retained runs with failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out conclusions for the failed-run ledger and streak inputs.
queries.objective: Provide one consistent failure-conclusion evidence set to downstream Overview queries.
queries.acceptance: Each selected run has one of the four declared conclusions within the selected horizon; other conclusions remain outside this set, and missing run coverage is not interpreted as no failures.

queries.intent: List failed workflow runs that need operator attention.
queries.objective: Give operators the most recent observed failed runs to inspect in GitHub.
queries.acceptance: Unprojected run rows retain available conclusion, started-at, and run evidence fields in descending started-at order; inspect source logs and missing links before attributing a cause or declaring resolution.

queries.intent: Identify failed runs in the selected snapshot horizon so subsequent streak logic can use the same declarative failure definition.
queries.objective: Project distinct failure-run counts by organization, repository, workflow, and run for streak joins.
queries.acceptance: Each grouped run identity has a failing-runs count derived from failure-run-base in the selected horizon; this stage does not assert a consecutive streak or require action.

queries.intent: Identify only workflows that have at least one failed run in the selected snapshot horizon before computing streaks.
queries.objective: Provide workflow identities with observed failed runs for the streak computation.
queries.acceptance: Each organization/repository/workflow group has a distinct failing-runs count from overview-failing-runs; the count covers observed failures, not the latest consecutive streak.

queries.intent: Group each workflow's latest consecutive failing run sequence in the selected snapshot horizon, resetting the group after any successful run.
queries.objective: Project the latest observed consecutive failure-count per workflow for downstream blocked-work matching.
queries.acceptance: failure-count follows run ordering and the declared latest-failure-streak reducer, with non-failing runs breaking the streak; missing earlier runs or incomplete snapshots limit the observed sequence.

queries.intent: Attach selected-horizon failure counts to each workflow's latest canonical work item.
queries.objective: Pair blocked work items with observed workflow failure streaks and retained run evidence before attention filtering.
queries.acceptance: Candidates are filtered to blocked items with a matching organization/repository/workflow streak; is-repeated reflects failure-count greater than one, while selected evidence-link and run-link can be absent or refer to the work item rather than the latest failed run.

execution.reason: Requires work-items, which the local SQLite projection does not provide.

queries.intent: Keep only unresolved workflows with two or more failures in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Surface blocked workflow items with observed repeated failures for bounded run investigation.
queries.acceptance: Every row inherits a blocked item with is-repeated true and projects evidence-link and run-link when available; verify run order, links, and current state before treating the failure as still unresolved.

execution.reason: Requires work-items, which the local SQLite projection does not provide.

queries.intent: Select only unresolved outputs explicitly awaiting human review with their retained GitHub evidence destination.
queries.objective: Present review-state work items and their retained GitHub destination to a human reviewer.
queries.acceptance: Rows are filtered to lifecycle-state review and project the work-item ID as attention-signal-id, plus reason, evidence-link, and run-link where present; reviewer disposition must be checked at source.

execution.reason: Requires work-items, which the local SQLite projection does not provide.

queries.intent: Combine grouped repeated failures and unresolved review outputs without introducing ordinary activity or duplicate work items.
queries.objective: Prioritize observed blocked repeated-failure work and review-state outputs for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Rows come only from the repeated-failure or review inputs and retain their source reasons, links, and ordering; confirm fresh source status before acting, and do not equate a missing row with resolved work.

queries.intent: Summarize one domain entity for its dedicated Insights view.
queries.objective: Identify domain decisions with request volume worth investigating before considering any egress change.
queries.acceptance: For the selected domain, request totals match the retained domain observations grouped by decision; missing data or blocked traffic does not establish a need for access, which requires underlying request and policy review.

queries.intent: Summarize one tool entity for its dedicated Insights view.
queries.objective: Select a tool and status combination whose recorded call volume merits investigation.
queries.acceptance: For the selected tool, observation counts match retained MCP call observations grouped by server, tool, and status; missing calls are not zero usage and status counts do not establish effectiveness or cause.

queries.intent: Summarize one audit event entity for its dedicated Insights view.
queries.objective: Select an audit summary and status requiring closer review of underlying observations.
queries.acceptance: For the selected summary, counts agree with retained audit observation IDs grouped by event status; repeated observations are not silently treated as distinct incidents, and absence does not prove no findings.
